sources.publication_semantics: EDGAR submissions and XBRL APIs update as filings are disseminated; individual facts carry filing/accession metadata but aggregate Company Facts must be reconstructed by filing/accession to preserve first-known values.
source_quality_notes: No authentication/API key required for data.sec.gov.
Current aggregate Company Facts must not be treated as a ready-made PIT panel.
8C ingestion must key facts by accession/filed timestamp and preserve later amendments/restatements as later versions.

sources.publication_semantics: Submission history is disseminated by EDGAR and can be anchored no earlier than the public filing acceptance/dissemination time. Event meaning still requires a separate deterministic extractor and source hierarchy.
source_quality_notes: SAFE refers only to filing/publication timestamp and accession identity, not to any yet-unvalidated event classifier.
A later amended filing must remain a new version and may not overwrite the original event record.

sources.publication_semantics: The documented EARNINGS_ESTIMATES endpoint returns annual/quarterly EPS and revenue estimates with analyst counts and revision history, but accepts only function, symbol and API key. It exposes no historical as-of/date parameter and the official documentation does not establish immutable per-observation publication timestamps.
source_quality_notes: UNSAFE classification is for retrospective Phase-8B backtesting, not for prospective snapshot collection.
A current response cannot be assigned to an earlier scanner date merely because it contains revision-history fields.
Could be reconsidered for a future prospective-only revision ledger if snapshots are archived from ingestion time onward.

sources.publication_semantics: The trends endpoint exposes current EPS/revenue consensus, 7/30/60/90-day prior trend values and revision counts for many fiscal periods, but the endpoint has no date/as-of parameters. Its `date` field is explicitly the fiscal period end, not the observation/vintage timestamp, and estimate fields move as analysts publish.
source_quality_notes: UNSAFE for reconstructing what the scanner could have known on an arbitrary historical date.
7/30/60/90-day trend fields are relative to the response state, not a queryable historical vintage.
Could support prospective collection only if every response is archived with ingestion/publication semantics from now onward.

sources.publication_semantics: Provider documents historical estimate/revision feeds with date filters and 20+ years of history. Historical access is Enterprise-only and history requires separate commercial access/payment.
source_quality_notes: Best-documented PIT revisions source found in 8A.
Not economically/access-cleared for this project: Enterprise access is required and historical data is not included in default plans.
SAFE source semantics do not override RESTRICTED access/license status.

sources.publication_semantics: Financial Estimates documentation exposes forward consensus by fiscal date, but does not establish dated historical EPS/revenue consensus snapshots suitable for strict revision backtesting.
source_quality_notes: Do not use current analyst-estimate rows to reconstruct past consensus.
Historical ratings are not a substitute for historical EPS/revenue estimate vintages.

sources.publication_semantics: Short interest is reported twice monthly and publicly disseminated later; research valid_from must be the publication date, never the settlement date. Corrections can replace prior values with revision flags.
source_quality_notes: Historical PIT use is contaminated if a later correction is retrojected without an archived original release.
Prospective use can be clean if every publication is stored as received.

sources.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED/ALFRED
sources.publication_semantics: ALFRED explicitly stores real-time periods/vintage dates so observations can be queried as known on a historical date. Research must use the real-time period/vintage rather than release date alone.
source_quality_notes: PIT-safe at the data-vintage level.
License/copyright must be checked per underlying series/source before persistent redistribution.
Macro data cannot become security evidence before a versioned exposure map is validated.

8A_decision.reason: No revisions source is simultaneously PIT-safe for historical scanner dates, accessible/licensed for this project, and economically cleared. Using Alpha Vantage or EODHD retrospectively would violate the Phase-8 PIT contract; Intrinio requires Enterprise historical access.
phase8b_reopen_conditions: obtain a historical revisions feed with immutable as-of/vintage timestamps and acceptable license/cost
or accumulate a sufficiently long prospective archived revisions ledger without retrojection
